name: specguard
description: Turns a plain-English spec into typed, EARS-formatted constraints, hands code generation to your own agent, then generates and runs one test per constraint in an isolated git worktree and scores the result 0-100.

specguard.providers.constraintExtraction.description: Provider id used to extract and classify EARS constraints from the spec.

specguard.providers.codeGeneration.description: Provider id used to generate code that satisfies the approved constraints.

specguard.providers.testGeneration.description: Provider id used to generate one test per constraint.

specguard.providers.scoring.description: Provider id used to score generated code quality. Can differ from the code-generation provider.

specguard.gate.minScore.description: Minimum overall quality score (0-100) required to pass the quality gate.

specguard.testFramework.description: Test framework to run generated tests with. "auto" detects it from the target project.

specguard.scoring.enforceDifferentProvid.description: Block a run when the scoring provider is the same as the code-generation provider, so scoring stays an independent check.

specguard.claudeAgentSdk.model.description: Model name/alias passed to the Claude Agent SDK. Leave empty to use the SDK's default. Authentication is read from the environment (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) or the Claude CLI's own login, never from a VSCode setting.
